Patient Portal Overview

Welcome to a smarter way to manage your care.

The Dior Medical Patient Portal puts your entire healthcare experience in one place. No more juggling phone calls, paper forms, or waiting days for a callback. Everything you need lives inside one secure dashboard, available anytime, from any device.

What you can do from your dashboard:

Appointments

Book, reschedule, or cancel appointments instantly.

Secure Messaging

Message your care team directly and securely.

Lab Results

View lab results and medical records the moment they're ready.

Prescription Refills

Refill prescriptions without a phone call.

Billing & Payments

Pay bills and check coverage details online.

Telehealth Visits

Join phone or video consultations from home.

E-Prescriptions

Digital Prescriptions & E-Prescribing

Prescriptions sent straight to your pharmacy, no paper required.

How e-prescribing works:

  • Your provider prescribes your medication during or after your visit
  • It's transmitted electronically, directly to your chosen pharmacy
  • You receive a confirmation notification in your portal
  • Need a renewal? Request it with one click, no callback required

E-prescribing isn’t just faster. It’s safer, with fewer errors and better tracking of your medication history over time

Request a prescription renewal in seconds through your portal.

Pharmacy & Refills

Pharmacy Information & Prescription Fulfillment

Track your prescription from the doctor’s desk to the pharmacy counter.

Stay on top of every prescription with:

  • Real-time fulfillment status updates
  • Your preferred pharmacy's contact details and hours
  • Estimated pickup times
  • Easy options to switch or update your preferred pharmacy
  • Refill reminders so you never run out unexpectedly

Managing medications should be simple, predictable, and stress-free. That’s exactly what this feature delivers.

Check your prescription status and manage your pharmacy preferences now.

Care Plans

Treatment Recommendations & Care Plans

A clear roadmap for your health, built specifically around you.

Your care plan keeps you on track with:

  • Documented treatment recommendations after every visit
  • Follow-up testing or specialist referrals, clearly outlined
  • Lifestyle and self-care guidance from your provider
  • Progress tracking against your health goals
  • Reminders for follow-up actions and check-ins

For chronic condition management or long-term treatment plans, this ongoing visibility keeps you engaged and accountable to your own health goals.

Review your personalized care plan and stay on track with your health goals.

Notifications

Patient Notifications & Communication

Stay informed without lifting a finger.

You’ll be notified automatically about:

  • Upcoming appointment reminders
  • New lab results and reports
  • Prescription renewal confirmations
  • Billing updates and payment due dates
  • Secure messages from your care team

Choose how you want to be reached, email, text, or in-portal alerts, and adjust your preferences anytime. Have a quick question between visits? Send a secure message directly through the portal instead of waiting on hold.

Turn on notifications and message your care team directly today.
